next.reason: 1985 reference-modifies data-name-1 ( leftmost-character-position: [ length ] ), with data-name-1 only qualified or subscripted (SR4). §2023:8.4.3.3.2 writes identifier-1( leftmost-position : [ length ] ); the renamed position operand is no difference. Identifier-1 admits more: §2023:8.4.3.3.3 SR2 "If identifier-1 is a function-identifier, it shall reference an alphanumeric, boolean, or national function", so a reference-modified function reference that 1985 refuses is accepted; §2023:8.4.3.3.3 SR3 still refuses a reference-modified identifier-1 ("Identifier-1 shall not be a reference-modification format identifier"), as 1985 data-name-1 did. Every 1985 form keeps its meaning; cases are added, no refusal became an exception.
